title: Decomposition of Sparse Integer Programs via Nonlinear Edge Encodings and Column-and-Row Generation
summary: A wide range of sparse integer programs admit a block structure in which subproblems interact through a small set of shared variables. Dualizing the linking equalities yields a decomposable Lagrangian relaxation, but generally introduces a duality gap. Recent work shows that this gap can be closed while preserving decomposability by dualizing exponentially large families of redundant nonlinear consistency constraints on the shared variables.
